description: Helm chart for eks-upgrade-advisor — a one-shot Job that auto-discovers EKS addons and ArgoCD-managed Helm charts and generates an EKS upgrade compatibility report.
rules: This chart deploys a batch/v1 Job, not a Deployment — the tool runs once and exits
config.clusterName and config.targetEksVersion are required; helm install fails fast without them
The report is retrieved via `kubectl logs job/<name>` — job.yaml overrides the ENTRYPOINT to cat the report to stdout after the run, no PVC or kubectl cp needed
RBAC (get/list on applications.argoproj.io) is always created when rbac.create and serviceAccount.create are both true — it is the tool's core discovery mechanism, not an opt-in feature
rbac.namespaced=true switches from a cluster-wide ClusterRole to a namespaced Role — pair it with config.argocdNamespace
AWS access is via IRSA only (serviceAccount.annotations['eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn']) — there is no chart field for inline AWS credentials
secrets.copilotCli.existingSecret is for production; secrets.copilotCli.token is inline, dev/test only
job.ttlSecondsAfterFinished controls how long the completed Job (and its logs) stay retrievable before Kubernetes garbage-collects it
